subject: Implement explicit workspaces in the workspace adapter: session handles, inspect, declaration-driven initialize with dry-run digest and journal, open/status/close, async lock and full mutation expectation
description:
WHY: the spec's sections on workspace identity and authorization, initialization, common results (handle, summary, mutation expectation) and the workspace rows of agent tools. It also builds the resume inputs for task 10.

GROUNDING:
- The server's workspace is fixed at start (tools.ts:132-136, index.ts:12-14) and reopened on every call (tools.ts:170-172; session.ts:33-61). The refusal asks for a restart (tools.ts:175).
- init: the scaffold is fixed (init.ts:17-25); InitSteps staging at :28-44 and :102-120; overlap refused at :56-70 and :96-100; no dry run and no journal.
- writeModel compares only the model revision (write.ts:10-14, :22-35).
- The lock: lock.ts:7-9, :29-71 (O_EXCL, pid-only liveness, a synchronous Atomics.wait poll).
- Containment: paths.ts:20-58, :109-111; repo.ts:7. installOutputs plans (outputs.ts:234) and renames (:249-266) without re-checking.
- Discovery excludes node_modules, dist, bin, obj, .git, .angular and coverage (discover.ts:190).
- WorkflowState: workspace.schema.json:102-140. Accepted baseline: baseline.ts:96. ResumeInputs: packages/core/src/resume.ts:27-50.
